title: 特定操作或状态导致性能下降
description: 大量工作订单、手工制作的站点、大型飞船、保存更新等特定游戏元素或操作导致性能下降、减速或冻结。
evidence: if you order enough things to happen, your game will crawl as your crew and characters check 'every' single one of them for availability
any handcrafted stations make the game chug
The game will enter into a massive slowdown, or refuse to save, or freeze, or take forever to save.

evidence_items.quote: The simulation speed will crawl to a halt if you got any larger-scale ship going with multiple work orders.
evidence_items.description: 大型飞船多工作订单时模拟速度骤降
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你让任何较大规模的飞船带着多个工作订单运转，模拟速度就会慢到几乎停滞。

evidence_items.quote: The game will enter into a massive slowdown, or refuse to save, or freeze, or take forever to save.
evidence_items.description: 游戏会随机进入严重减速、无法保存或冻结
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏会进入大规模卡顿，或者拒绝保存，或者冻结，或者保存要花上永远那么久。

evidence_items.quote: if you order enough things to happen, your game will crawl as your crew and characters check 'every' single one of them for availability
evidence_items.description: 大量工作订单导致游戏卡顿，因为角色会逐一检查所有订单
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你下令让足够多的事情发生，你的游戏就会变得极其缓慢，因为你的船员和角色会检查“每一个”任务的可用性

evidence_items.quote: the performance will choke and die if you trying building your cargo ship all at once
evidence_items.description: 一次性建造货船时性能严重下降
evidence_items.quote_zh: 如果你试图一次性建造你的货船，性能会卡死并崩溃

evidence_items.quote: any handcrafted stations make the game chug
evidence_items.description: 手工制作的站点导致游戏卡顿
evidence_items.quote_zh: 任何手工制作的站点都会让游戏卡顿

evidence_items.quote: the game hits an update tick and locks up for a minute straight, which is frequent
evidence_items.description: 游戏在更新时卡住一分钟，且频繁发生
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏遇到更新tick就会卡死整整一分钟，而且这种情况很频繁
